`integration_links`: one link per `(org_id, product_code)`; column `kind` (`provision` for a new org, `migrate` for a standalone customer), `tenant_ref` (product tenant/host id), `status` (`pending`, `confirmed`, `finalized`, `unlinked`); product data is never moved between databases.

`migrate` link: the org admin creates a link in the console, the platform shows a single-use link code (only the HMAC is stored); the standalone tenant admin enters the code in product settings; the product calls `LinkService/Confirm(link_code, product_code, tenant_ref, local_users[])` with the service token; the link becomes `confirmed`. A running standalone product does not change until finalisation (dual-run).

Requirement: `provision` link: when a product's entitlement first becomes active for an org without a link, the platform creates a `pending` link and sends `platform.tenant.provision_requested` (`link_id`, `org_id`, org name, owner) via `Deliver`; the product creates the tenant idempotently per `org_id` with initial configuration, sets `tenants.org_id`, then calls `LinkService/Confirm`; the link becomes `finalized` immediately because there are no local users.
Evidence: Tenant provisioning behaviour in `suite` mode by the platform is stated in `POS-Stery/docs/BRD_POS.id.md` (BR-POS-21)

Requirement: User mapping (`user_product_links`: `org_id`, `user_id`, `product_code`, `external_ref`): automatic only when the local user's email equals the email of a platform member already verified by OTP; otherwise the admin assigns manually or invites; a local user without a pair cannot log in after finalisation until paired.

`migrate` finalisation: the admin presses finalise in the console; the platform sends `platform.link.finalized` via `Deliver`; the product sets `tenants.org_id` (SELA: `hosts.org_id`), revokes that tenant's native sessions, disables native login, writes audit, and answers ack; the link becomes `finalized`.

Unlinking and returning to standalone: a `finalized` link may become `unlinked`; detailed behaviour (whether native login is re-enabled, the fate of users created on the platform) `tbd` (OQ-F10); before finalisation, unlinking changes nothing on the product.

SELA: nullable columns `hosts.org_id` and `hosts.external_subject` used only in suite mode; the host is created just-in-time on the first suite login (email from the Principal encrypted with `piicrypt` because of constraint `hosts_contact_present`); a host without `org_id` stays standalone; no RLS change (D-SUI-08).

`IntegrationService/Publish`: accepts a batch of envelopes from the product outbox; rejects invalid envelopes (`event_id` not a UUIDv7, `org_id` not linked to the calling product, `event_type` absent from the manifest's `events_published`); idempotent per `event_id`.

Routing and opt-in: the platform writes `deliveries` only when the org is entitled to `integration.<a>_<b>` and the admin has enabled `integration_subscriptions` for the product pair and event kind; platform control events (`platform.tenant.provision_requested`, `platform.link.finalized`, `platform.entitlement.changed`) are always delivered to that org's products.

`DeliveryService/Deliver` in the product: at-least-once; consumers must be idempotent via `processed_events` per `(consumer, event_id)`; a transient error yields a nack so it is retried; the target tenant is mapped from `org_id`.

Retry, dead-letter, and manual retry: doubling backoff; attempt limit and interval `tbd` (SELA pattern: doubling up to 5 attempts); beyond the limit it becomes `dead`; the operator can monitor and retry (`POST /api/v1/admin/deliveries/{delivery_id}/retry`).

`schema_version` policy: a compatible change raises the minor version without changing `event_type`; an incompatible change uses a new `event_type` or major version; a consumer receiving an unknown major version rejects it to dead-letter, never silently ignores it.

The employee <-> POS user mapping is created by an admin (not automatic).

INT-3, a POS store event creates a SELA event and invites opted-in loyalty customers (feature `integration.pos_sel`): POS has neither a store-event concept nor customer consent yet (event name `tbd`, FSD_POS); invitations only for customers with recorded consent; delivery via the notification hub.

The 19-item STACK-SPEC conformance checklist (table below) runs as `scripts/conformance.sh` and as a manual pass/fail recorded in the product FSD section 2.1; one failing item means the product does not yet meet the Product Contract.
A BRD, PRD, FSD document triple in SELA house style (header table, `Evidence` column, traceability matrix 11.1-11.3) for every new product; HRS and POS: BRD and FSD (POS uses `POS-Stery/PRD.md`).

Suite deployment profile (`deploy/docker-compose.yml` with a suite profile) runs the platform and three products without port collisions per the map in 2.5.4; each product's standalone profile is unchanged.

One PostgreSQL 18 server with four databases (`stery_platform`, `hris`, `pos`, `sela`); one application role per database (NOBYPASSRLS for platform, HRS, POS) and a separate migration role; no cross-database FKs; cross-product references are UUID + column `external_ref`.
Evidence: Current roles in POS: `POS-Stery/deploy/docker/init-postgres.sql`; SELA migrations do not use RLS: `SELA/apps/api/internal/db/migrations`

Requirement: One Dragonfly per product (6379 SELA, 6380 platform, 6381 HRIS, 6382 POS); one RustFS with one bucket and one access key per product; shared ClamAV with profile `scan`.

Caddy: one parent domain, web and `/api` routes per product on the same origin as its web (the API has no CORS), `TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS` set, `COOKIE_SECURE=true`; `stery_session` cookie domain `tbd` (OQ-3).
The suite profile does not use `:latest` tags: Dragonfly, RustFS, aws-cli, and ClamAV images are pinned to a tag or digest (RISK-SUI-13).

Quality gate for platform and `kit`: `scripts/check.sh` (proto drift, gofmt, vet, golangci-lint, `go test -cover`, svelte-check, vitest with coverage, real-stack e2e), `CHECK_STAGES`, CI jobs go/web/e2e, 80% coverage floor, `-race` in CI.
Baseline observability: `log/slog` JSON, `/healthz`, request id propagated between gRPC calls (`x-request-id`); OpenTelemetry/Prometheus optional as a separate `kit` module, `tbd` (D-SUI-11, OQ-2).
Standalone-mode independence: each product runs all its tests and e2e without the platform at every stage S1-S5 (a "no platform" CI job); paid features in standalone mode never call the platform.
Cookie `stery_session`: HttpOnly, Secure (except local development `COOKIE_SECURE=false`), SameSite=Lax, Path `/`, Domain per OQ-3; expiry follows session TTL; cleared on logout.
No JWT and no token in `localStorage` or JSON; session only as an HttpOnly cookie; Dragonfly stores only the HMAC; logs and audit never contain tokens.

HMAC service token between products and platform: `product_code`, time, nonce, signature; clock tolerance `tbd`; replay protection via `svcnonce`; per-product secret with rotation (the previous secret is accepted during the transition period); constant-time comparison.
Evidence: Reference for keyed HMAC and rotation: `SELA/apps/api/internal/piicrypt/piicrypt.go`, `SELA/apps/api/services/auth/service.go`

Requirement: Platform-product gRPC transport: TLS mandatory when calls cross hosts or an untrusted network; on a single host over loopback plaintext is allowed and documented. A raw session token crosses `Introspect`, so this is stricter than POS's current plaintext gRPC (OQ-F8).

Platform RLS: `ENABLE`+`FORCE`, `tenant_isolation` policy with `USING` and `WITH CHECK` over `current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)::uuid`, NOBYPASSRLS application role, separate migration role; cross-tenant tests mandatory for every module (org A cannot read or write org B data).
Evidence: RLS precedent in POS (`pos_admin` BYPASSRLS only for migrations, `pos_app` subject to RLS): `POS-Stery/deploy/docker/init-postgres.sql`

Requirement: User email and phone, invitation email, and notification payloads are encrypted with `kit/piicrypt` (AES-256-GCM, per-purpose AAD, key ID on the ciphertext, HMAC blind index for lookup, previous key for rotation); keys only from the environment; without a key, the platform refuses to start in production (unlike SELA which only warns).

Fail-closed Dragonfly rate limiter on OTP request, verification, password login, invitations, links, and webhooks, per address and per connection address; the connection address is read through `httpx.TrustedProxies` only for trusted proxies.

Secrets are never in the repo or logs: `.env.example` without secret values, fail-fast validation, config prints redacted values; secret scanning becomes a `check.sh` stage (`tbd`); no binaries in the repo.

Cross-site request protection: API only on the same origin as its web with no CORS; state-changing operations check the `Origin` header against the console origin; SameSite=Lax; Caddy security headers (HSTS, `nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, CSP).

UU PDP data subject rights: users can request a copy and deletion or anonymisation of their identity data; platform deletion anonymises `users` and links audit to a pseudonym, without deleting billing records that must be retained; retention policy and DPO role `tbd`.

Cross-product data minimisation: the platform stores only identity and organisation metadata; NIK, NPWP, date of birth, and POS transaction data are never replicated to the platform or to other products; event payloads are limited to identifiers and minimum attributes.
Payment webhook: signature verified, amount matched, repeated notifications idempotent, and invalid notifications answered without leaking keys.

Requirement: Sistem mendukung pengaturan ulang urutan tampilan item Hall of Fame.
Evidence: PUT /api/v1/events/{event_id}/hall-of-fame/order with the full list, one transaction, two-step renumbering against the non-deferrable unique index, rollback proven with an injected failure; stale, duplicate, foreign and incomplete lists refused; Up/Down buttons disabled at the ends and while a request runs; order survives a reload and is what a guest sees (Chrome e2e); full gate exit 0. Drag and drop not built

Requirement: Sistem otomatis mengeluarkan media dari Hall of Fame bila media tersebut dihapus/disembunyikan.
Evidence: Hiding or deleting a Hall of Fame photo clears its flag and compacts the ranks in the same transaction; guests stop seeing it at once; tested in Go and in Chrome e2e

Requirement: (Opsional) Sistem menyediakan daftar kandidat berdasarkan jumlah reaksi tamu sebagai saran kurasi.
Sistem menyediakan layar rekam pesan suara di PWA tamu dengan rekam, indikator durasi, putar ulang, rekam ulang, dan kirim, tanpa login.
Evidence: Go tests against the real database, Vitest and Chrome e2e with a fake microphone; not verified on real phones or iOS Safari

Requirement: Sistem membatasi durasi per pesan dan jumlah pesan per tamu sesuai konfigurasi event; nilai ditegakkan di server, bukan hanya di klien.
Evidence: Go tests against the real database, Vitest and Chrome e2e with a fake microphone; not verified on real phones or iOS Safari

Requirement: Sistem mengunggah rekaman lewat URL bertanda tangan berumur pendek dan menyimpan sebagai media `kind = voice` dengan `duration_ms`.
Evidence: Go tests against the real database, Vitest and Chrome e2e with a fake microphone; not verified on real phones or iOS Safari

Requirement: Sistem menyediakan daftar pesan suara per event bagi host (pemutar, nama panggilan tamu bila ada, waktu kirim, unduh), tanpa syarat reveal.
Evidence: Go tests against the real database, Vitest and Chrome e2e with a fake microphone; not verified on real phones or iOS Safari

Requirement: Sistem menegakkan di tingkat kueri bahwa pesan suara hanya dapat diakses oleh host event tersebut dan sesi tamu pengirimnya.
Evidence: Go tests against the real database, Vitest and Chrome e2e with a fake microphone; not verified on real phones or iOS Safari

Requirement: Host dapat mengaktifkan atau mematikan fitur pesan suara per event; bawaan nonaktif untuk event `involves_minors`.
Evidence: Go tests against the real database, Vitest and Chrome e2e with a fake microphone; not verified on real phones or iOS Safari

Requirement: Host dapat menyembunyikan atau menghapus pesan suara melalui modul moderasi (4.7).
Evidence: Go tests against the real database, Vitest and Chrome e2e with a fake microphone; not verified on real phones or iOS Safari

Requirement: Sistem menyertakan pesan suara dalam ekspor ZIP host (4.6) sebagai berkas audio terpisah dari foto/video.
Evidence: Go tests against the real database, Vitest and Chrome e2e with a fake microphone; not verified on real phones or iOS Safari

Requirement: (Opsional) Sistem mengirim notifikasi ke host saat pesan suara baru masuk, dengan agregasi agar tidak membanjiri (4.8).
Sistem menyajikan seluruh media hanya melalui pre-signed URL berumur pendek; tidak ada objek yang dapat diakses publik secara permanen.
Evidence: media only via short-lived pre-signed PUT/GET on a private bucket; separate media domain not done; MEDIA_ORIGIN_REQUIRED makes the API refuse to start when S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT shares the web app's origin (T34.4); the production domain is not set up.

Requirement: Sistem membersihkan metadata EXIF (termasuk koordinat GPS) dari seluruh media sebelum disimpan.
Evidence: EXIF/GPS and all other metadata stripped from JPEG/PNG/WebP before storage; HEIC and video refused until T8.4; every upload is streamed to clamd before it is cleaned, a hit is 422 and no answer is 503 (T34.3); verified against a fake clamd only.

Requirement: Sistem memvalidasi tipe berkas unggahan berdasarkan magic bytes dan menolak berkas yang tidak sesuai.
Evidence: magic bytes must match the declared type for JPEG/PNG/WebP

Requirement: Sistem menyimpan token pada cookie HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite dan menyediakan mekanisme pencabutan token.
Evidence: HttpOnly/SameSite cookie, hashed expiring tokens, and POST /api/v1/auth/logout revoking the session server side (REST only; no refresh token by decision D8); Go tests and Vitest, e2e still open

Requirement: Sistem mengenkripsi kolom PII (email, nomor HP) pada PostgreSQL dengan kunci terpisah dari kunci media.
Evidence: host email/phone AES-256-GCM + HMAC blind index, env keys, rotation with previous keys, legacy rows upgraded on sign-in and at start; guest nicknames not encrypted; no secret-manager integration

Requirement: Sistem mencatat audit log append-only untuk seluruh aksi sensitif tanpa memuat PII/token mentah.
Evidence: append-only audit_logs plus GET /api/v1/admin/audit for audit:read holders and the /admin log view; Go tests on Postgres and Vitest

Requirement: Sistem memungkinkan pemilik event mencabut tautan/QR event maupun tautan berbagi yang telah dibuat.
Evidence: Event link and QR revocation (migration 0017) plus the existing revocable Hall of Fame link; Go tests against PostgreSQL and Vitest, e2e still open; a revocation cannot be undone yet

Requirement: Sistem menghapus seluruh salinan data (storage, basis data, cache, backup) saat masa simpan berakhir atau atas permintaan penghapusan yang sah.
Evidence: Objects of ended events and of deleted photos past their undo window are removed, archives expire after 24 hours; retention is opt-in via RETENTION_DAYS_*. Media rows are deleted MEDIA_ROW_PURGE_DAYS (default 30) after their object, with the reports about them (T34.5); backups and caches are not touched; no deletion on the data subject's request; no expiry notice

Requirement: Sistem menerapkan rate limiting berbasis Redis pada endpoint OTP, unggah, dan pembuatan tautan berbagi.
Evidence: Redis rate limiting on OTP endpoints and on guest-session creation and uploads (20 sessions/10 min/IP, 60 uploads/10 min/session, 300 uploads/10 min/IP, fail-closed); share-link creation limit pending; creation of the Hall of Fame link is limited per host (T30.1)

Requirement: Sistem menyertakan header X-Robots-Tag: noindex pada seluruh halaman galeri dan media agar tidak terindeks mesin pencari.
Evidence: X-Robots-Tag noindex, nofollow on every guest API route and the host gallery; web pages carry a robots meta in app.html and the reference Caddyfile sends the header (T34.6)

Requirement: Sistem memvalidasi pesan suara (magic bytes `audio/webm`/`audio/mp4`, ukuran dan durasi maksimum di server), membersihkan metadata kontainer, memindai malware sebelum `ready`, menyajikannya hanya ke host event dan sesi pengirim lewat pre-signed URL, dan menerapkan rate limit unggah yang sama dengan FR-SEC.9. Rekaman suara diperlakukan sebagai data pribadi (8.11): pemberitahuan privasi sebelum merekam dan penghapusan sesuai FR-SEC.8.
Evidence: Voice notes are checked by magic bytes (audio/webm, audio/mp4), size and duration on the server and kept out of the photo gallery; no malware scan yet (D3, U6).
